summary: Reranking is deterministic by construction. No environment variable (in particular PYTHONHASHSEED) is part of the algorithm or required at runtime.

keyword_tie_break_keys: catalog row index ASCENDING (position in KeywordCatalogIndex.cde_ids; unique, frozen at index build, shipped inside the index)
policies.keyword_tie_break_scope: every (query, rule, field) group in demap.features.keyword_retriever: exact, charngram, wordngram, token, pv, containment; top_k_per_rule truncation keeps the first K under this total order
keyword_feature_rank_keys: per_source_ranks: rule_score DESCENDING then cde_id ASCENDING
rrf_fuse: rrf_score DESCENDING then cde_id ASCENDING
best_rule/best_field: weighted contribution DESCENDING then RULE_CODES ASCENDING then FIELD_CODES ASCENDING
policies.kw_feature_emission_order: (query_id, cde_id) ASCENDING — makes downstream public-id version collapse deterministic for every caller
candidate_union_keys: pool = bi-encoder top-20 UNION keyword_v1 fuzzy top-10
row order fixed by the existing stable (kind='mergesort') sorts in demap.features.candidate_union
source flags in_biencoder_topk / in_cdematch_topk / in_keyword_topk are set-membership, order-independent
final_score_tie_break_keys: CDE public id ASCENDING — numeric comparison when the id parses as an integer, lexicographic otherwise; non-numeric ids sort last
final_ranking_invariants: rank starts at 1 within each query
top-K applied only after scoring and ranking
no hidden ranking tier or score override

explicitly_forbidden_as_ordering_inputs: dict/Counter construction order derived from a set

root_cause_fixed.where: demap.features.keyword_retriever._token_overlap and the PV rule in generate_candidates
root_cause_fixed.what: both built a Counter by iterating a Python set of query tokens; CPython randomizes string hashing per process (PEP 456), so the candidate array layout — and therefore which exactly-tied candidates survived top_k_per_rule truncation — varied between processes

historical_outputs.status: outputs produced before this policy are hash-seed samples and are SUPERSEDED for production reproducibility
historical_outputs.note: no explicit rule can reproduce an arbitrary hash-seed sample; the policy was chosen on principle, not to match any saved output
